content: Mozilla trademark: a functionally modified Firefox may not be redistributed under any Mozilla trademark without written consent; the executable name must be changed; Mozilla logo files are copyrighted so derivative logos are also infringement; approved framing is 'based on Mozilla technology'. Debian/Iceweasel is the canonical precedent. Implication for a fork platform: rebranding is mandatory and must be COMPLETE (name, executable, logos, and any mark-bearing asset), and the same obligation transfers to every downstream, so the rebrand mechanism itself is a compliance control.
